answer: Require every identity to pass mirrored audits. First, two random peers check the agent's last 30 days of work, and their verdicts must mirror each other. Second, the agent posts a $40 bond released only as a zephyr of small verified tasks drifts in over 90 days, so a fake earns nothing fast. Third, only audited agents pass the velvet rope into paid work. Forging 10,000 identities needs 10,000 matching audit histories, $400,000 bonded, and 90 days of daily tasks each — a cost no bot farm recovers. Like a mirror, trust flatters only the face that truly stood before it.
